# [BUG] movie-service tests unrunnable locally: mongo:8.0 refuses to start on kernel 6.19+

## Bug
`./gradlew :backend:movie-service:test` fails 55 of 135 tests on this machine. Every failure traces to the shared MongoDB Testcontainer never starting — `Wait strategy failed. Container exited with code 1` — which then trips the Spring `ApplicationContext failure threshold`, cascading to 31 more.

Confirmed live, and it is not the code. Running the image directly gives the reason:

```
$ docker run --rm mongo:8.0
{"s":"F","c":"CONTROL","id":12257600,"msg":"MongoDB cannot start: Linux kernel
versions 6.19 and newer has a known incompatibility with this version of
MongoDB. See https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-121912"}
```

This host runs kernel `7.1.10-200.fc44.x86_64`, so `mongo:8.0` aborts on startup by design.

## Root Cause
MongoDB 8.0 refuses to start on Linux kernel 6.19+ (upstream SERVER-121912). The test suite pins `mongo:8.0`, so every Testcontainers-backed movie-service test is unrunnable locally on a current Fedora kernel. GitHub Actions runners are on an older kernel, which is why CI stays green and this only bites local runs.

## Severity vs. Priority
**Severity (technical impact):** Major
**Priority (business urgency):** P2

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `./gradlew :backend:movie-service:test` passes on a kernel 6.19+ host
- [ ] The MongoDB image version used by tests is pinned in one place rather than repeated across test classes
- [ ] CI still runs the same image version it runs today, or is updated deliberately alongside this

## Notes
Found while checking whether a `main` into `develop` reconciliation was safe. It is not caused by that merge: an identical run on unmerged `develop` fails the same 135/55 with the same container error, so the merge introduces no regression here.

Options worth weighing: bump to a MongoDB release carrying the kernel fix, or pin tests to the newest 8.0.x that starts on 6.19+.
